detail.longDescription: Anthropic Expands Mythos 5 Access to More Defenders, Unveils $35M Open Source Fund Anthropic expands AI cybersecurity access through partner integrations and enhanced Claude Security. New initiatives include the Mythos 5 model for actionable security alerts, a $35M Defender Advantage Fund for open source projects, and an expanded Cyber Verification Program. Focus: defensive outputs while limiting unrestricted model access. https://www. securityweek.com/anthropic-exp ands-mythos-5-access-to-more-defenders-unveils-35m-open-source-fund/ # AI # MachineLearning
